name: WooCommerce Bookings
couldBuild: A bookable product type, an availability calendar and a slot picker that writes an order. The demo looks finished quickly.
stillMissing: Availability is a deceptively hard problem: timezones and DST, buffer times, per-resource capacity, double-booking under concurrent requests, and two-way sync with Google Calendar. Every one of those bugs is a customer who turned up on the wrong day.
requirements: Bookable product type with per-day and per-slot availability rules
Timezone-correct slot generation, including DST transitions
Resource and capacity handling so two customers cannot take one slot
Buffer time, minimum notice and cancellation windows

alternatives.name: Amelia
alternatives.desc: Standalone booking rather than a WooCommerce extension.

alternatives.name: Bookly
alternatives.desc: Appointment-first, with a free tier that covers simple scheduling.

notes: Scored above Memberships mainly on timezone and concurrency risk, not on feature count.
